messages:
maria-partnerships: Quick sync — VeloraChip reached out requesting a 6-week preview for their new A1 SKU. They want NDA + benchmark window + joint feedback loop. Who can own the bench plan and lab cadence?

kevin-eng-ml: I can own the benchmark matrix. Need SKU spec and perf targets from Velora. Do we run 8k context testing or stick to 2k first? cc @sophia-ops for lab reservations.

sophia-ops: Lab availability looks OK next Tue/Wed (slots open). We'll need dev units shipped by Mon EOD, and a service account for our telemetry collector. Also flagging power/cooling check for A1 — might be higher draw.

alex-legal: NDA arrived this morning. Velora redlined an export-control clause and an embargo paragraph. I'll take the redline, will try to get to countersign by Thu EOD. If they insist on specific embargo language, ping me and I’ll coordinate.

james-hw: From Velora side: they want an open perf run using our latency-runner and two prompt sets (long-context and short-llm). They also asked for KV-cache persistence behavior notes. I can provide the sample prompt CSV and the device firmware image id.

ci-bot: perf-ci job created: https://ci.redwood.internal/bench/runs/4521 — queued, will run once kevin uploads matrix and we provision nodes.

maria-partnerships: Action items (owners):
- Kevin: draft bench matrix (axes & targets) by Wed EOD.
- Sophia: reserve lab Tue/Wed and confirm shipping/labeling instructions.
- Alex: finalize NDA + embargo language.
- James: share sample prompts + firmware id.
Please reply with any blockers. :thumbsup:

kevin-eng-ml: Drafting matrix now. Proposed axes: model family (gpt-small/gpt-medium), batch size (1/4), seq len (2048/8192), quant (fp16/q4_0), concurrency (1/4/8). Will include target p50/p95 latencies and token/s cost breakdown.

sophia-ops: Noted on power. If run >24h reserve, we need extra ops lead. Shipping note: label units with customer id VEL-A1 and rack to B3. Also request: provide serial numbers in the shipping manifest so we can map telemetry later.

james-hw: Sharing prompt set now: https://files.velorachip.dev/velora_prompts_v1.csv — contains 120 short prompts + 40 long-context. Firmware image: velora-a1-2026-03-01.img

maria-partnerships: Thanks. I'll schedule a kickoff with Velora PM for Mon and include legal on the invite. They mentioned coordinated press if numbers are strong — Alex, please ensure embargo terms are in NDA.

alex-legal: Will add embargo clause and send updated NDA to Velora counsel today.

maria-partnerships: One more ask from Velora: they want a lightweight feedback loop (weekly sync + shared issue tracker) and a template for test observations. I'll draft a short template and post it here once ready.

kevin-eng-ml: I'll attach a simple test-template in this thread tomorrow; includes columns for prompt-id, model, seq-len, batch, latency, mem, notes.

sophia-ops: If anyone needs GPU reservations beyond the two-day window, tell me now. Ops can extend but need lead time.

maria-partnerships: Great — keeping thread open. Please tag updates. I'll update Velora after NDA ack and when lab slots are locked.
